properties.description: Reusable native-only internal helper for Cisco Intersight - Start operating system installation. Keeps scalar preparation or polling below platform action and variable limits. No API calls, credentials or hardware targets. Import this helper before its caller; current-cloud native runtime verification remains required. Full internal purpose: Cisco Intersight - Native Start operating system installation - Prepare bounded native poll delay. Integer seconds are required by Cisco Calculate Date and Sleep. Fractional delays round up by less than one second; an expired deadline stops the next API call.
